query_text: Invent a new idiom---then spill the beans.

parts.text:
Here is a brand-new idiom, fresh out of the linguistic kitchen:

### **"Watering the plastic fern"**

---

### **Spilling the Beans: The Breakdown**

#### **1. What it means:**
To "water the plastic fern" means to engage in highly visible, effort-intensive work that is completely pointless, or to pour care and attention into something that is fundamentally incapable of growing, changing, or returning the favor. It is the ultimate metaphor for performative productivity, misplaced emotional labor, or sticking to a useless habit.

#### **2. The (fictional) Origin Story:**
The phrase originated in the early 2020s at a mid-sized tech startup. A newly hired, highly anxious junior developer wanted to make a great impression. Every Monday and Thursday at 9:00 AM sharp, they would take a watering can and meticulously care for a lush, leafy fern sitting in the corner of the conference room. They would mist its leaves, check its soil, and even whisper words of encouragement to it. 

This went on for eight months until the office decided to remodel. When the movers went to pick up the pot, they realized the "fern" was a high-end, $45 artificial plant from IKEA—and the pot didn't even have drainage holes; it was just a soggy soup of stagnant water at the bottom. 

The story leaked to the company Slack, and the phrase took off. It quickly spread outside the company to describe any task that *looks* like nurturing and hard work, but is actually a complete waste of water.

#### **3. How to use it in conversation:**

*   **In the workplace (for pointless busywork):**
    > *"Management has us writing detailed, 10-page weekly status reports for projects that were canceled last month. We're just watering the plastic fern at this point."*

*   **In relationships (for unrequited or useless effort):**
    > *"I've spent three years trying to get my brother to apologize for stealing my car, but I think I'm just watering the plastic fern. He's never going to change."*

*   **In daily life (for overcomplicating things):**
    > *"I spent two hours organizing my desktop icons by color. Talk about watering the plastic fern."*
